text: DSH ACP Adapter 将符合 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）的外部 Agent 接入 DSH 原生会话，并以独立模型路由提供选择。它通过设置面板配置 Agent 命令、参数和环境变量，接入原生会话流、工具审批与停止控制，并提供 ACP 活动记录、诊断、Agent 团队成员和审批界面。适合希望在 DSH 中复用 Devin、Claude、Codex、Kimi、Qwen Code 或自定义 ACP Agent 的用户；Agent CLI 需预先安装并登录在 DSH 主机上。

DSH ACP Adapter connects ACP agents to DSH session model routes. Configure commands, arguments, and environment in settings; use session streaming, approvals, and team views. Supports Devin, Claude, Codex, Kimi, Qwen Code, or custom agents. Install and sign in to the CLI on the DSH host.

DSH ACP Adapter 的功能「配置 ACP Agent」：设置面板接受 Agent 名称、启动命令、参数、环境变量和登录提示，宿主据配置建立独立 ACP 模型路由。
DSH ACP Adapter 的功能「在原生会话中使用 Agent」：ACP 路由接入 DSH 会话与原生对话界面；插件注册会话活动呈现、Agent 输出流和 Agent 模型选择相关 UI。
DSH ACP Adapter 的功能「控制工具审批与轮次」：用户可为新会话选择 auto 或 ask 审批默认策略，客户端为 ACP 权限请求呈现审批 UI，并提供 Agent 轮次控制。
DSH ACP Adapter 的功能「查看 ACP 活动与诊断」：客户端注册 ACP 活动和诊断界面；Remote 提供带分页游标的会话审计时间线及活动快照和详情。
DSH ACP Adapter 的功能「查看团队成员并处理审批」：启用 DSH Agent Teams 时，主会话可展示 ACP 团队成员控制和子会话审批，并允许打开成员会话。

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · 连接 Agent：插件附带一份 [ACP 官方 Agent 目录](https://agentclientprotocol.com/registry)快照，提供安装、登录指引和命令预填；也可手动添加目录外的 ACP Agent。Agent CLI 必须安装并登录在运行 DSH 的主机上。打开 **插件 → ACP 适配器**，按目录指引添加 Agent 并检查连接，再在新会话选择 Agent 模型。插件不会替你安装 CLI 或登录账号。以下 Agent 已做过实际接入测试：

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · 连接 Agent：| Agent                      | ACP 命令                                 | 认证               |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| Devin                      | `devin acp`                              | `devin auth login` |
| CodeBuddy CLI（WorkBuddy） | `codebuddy --acp`                        | `codebuddy`        |
| Antigravity                | `agy_acp_server.par`（官方 raw `1.3.0`） | ACP 独立登录       |
| Claude                     | `claude-agent-acp`                       | `claude`           |
| Codex                      | `codex-acp`                              | `codex login`      |
| Kimi                       | `kimi acp`                               | `kimi login`       |
| Qwen Code                  | `qwen --acp`                             | `qwen`             |

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · 连接 Agent：> CodeBuddy CLI 与 WorkBuddy 桌面端使用同一账号积分，无需分别订阅；通过 CodeBuddy CLI 接入 DSH。详见 [CodeBuddy 账号与订阅说明](https://www.codebuddy.cn/docs/ide/Account/pricing)及 [ACP 命令参考](https://www.codebuddy.cn/docs/cli/cli-reference)。

测试范围与限制见 [E2E 验证说明](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/blob/v0.2.1-rc.4.1/test/e2e/README.md)。

<summary>更多界面预览</summary>

</details>

**Auto** 可自动确认当前会话中 Agent 调用 DSH 工具的申请，不改变 DSH 的沙箱与工具授权。Devin 发出的授权请求仍需按原始选项确认。**Ask** 在 Agent 请求审批时显示原生审批卡。Agent 自带工具仍由 Agent 控制。**Stop** 取消当前轮次；Agent 自带工具是否停止仍由 Agent 管理，未报告结果的工具保留未完成状态。按 Enter 可排队输入，支持的 Agent 会在同一 Agent 会话继续。开启 DSH 的实验性 Agent Teams 后，可在主会话查看成员进度并处理审批。

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · 排障与反馈：| 现象                     | 先检查                                                         |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 命令无法启动             | 核对 Agent 可执行文件路径，尝试填写绝对路径。                  |
| 登录或认证失败           | 在 Agent CLI 登录，并检查已配置的环境变量。                    |
| 旧 subagent 详情无法打开 | 查看原生恢复提示；不兼容的旧详情会保留在本地记录中并显示错误。 |
| 会话提示需要恢复         | 按输入栏提示和 **ACP 诊断** 操作，不要清空本地数据。           |

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · 排障与反馈：在 **ACP 诊断**中可导出安全摘要 JSON；其中不含消息正文、命令、路径、原始会话 ID 或 ACP 凭据。DSH 原生会话日志 ZIP 可能含提示词、工具参数、文件路径和附件；分享前请检查并移除敏感信息。

需要求助时，向 [Issue](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/issues) 附上错误编号、DSH/插件版本和已脱敏的日志片段。技术边界见[原生复用说明](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/blob/v0.2.1-rc.4.1/docs/native-reuse.md)。

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Web：**Updates:** The plugin manager does not update plugins automatically. To update through the plugin manager, uninstall the old version, then install the new version using the recommended method above. Uninstalling the plugin does not uninstall an Agent or sign out of its account. To ensure the updated plugin is loaded, fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop after the current task finishes; for Web, restart the DSH service and refresh the page. You do not need to sign in again.

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Connect an Agent：The plugin ships with a snapshot of the [official ACP Agent catalog](https://agentclientprotocol.com/registry), with installation and sign-in guidance and command prefill. You can also add an ACP Agent manually. Install and sign in to the Agent CLI on the computer running DSH. Open **Plugins → ACP adapter**, follow the catalog guidance to add the Agent and check its connection, then choose its model in a new session. The plugin does not install CLIs or sign in to accounts. These Agents have completed real integration checks:

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Connect an Agent：| Agent                     | ACP command                                 | Authentication       |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Devin                     | `devin acp`                                 | `devin auth login`   |
| CodeBuddy CLI (WorkBuddy) | `codebuddy --acp`                           | `codebuddy`          |
| Antigravity               | `agy_acp_server.par` (official raw `1.3.0`) | Separate ACP sign-in |
| Claude                    | `claude-agent-acp`                          | `claude`             |
| Codex                     | `codex-acp`                                 | `codex login`        |
| Kimi                      | `kimi acp`                                  | `kimi login`         |
| Qwen Code                 | `qwen --acp`                                | `qwen`               |

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Connect an Agent：> CodeBuddy CLI and the WorkBuddy desktop app share account credits, with no separate subscription required. Connect DSH through the CodeBuddy CLI. See [CodeBuddy account and subscription details](https://www.codebuddy.cn/docs/ide/Account/pricing) and the [ACP CLI reference](https://www.codebuddy.cn/docs/cli/cli-reference).

For test coverage and limitations, see the [E2E verification guide](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/blob/v0.2.1-rc.4.1/test/e2e/README.md).

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Preview：**Auto** can automatically confirm Agent requests to use the current session's DSH tools, without changing DSH's sandbox or tool permissions. Permission requests from Devin still require your choice from the original options. **Ask** shows the native approval card when the Agent requests approval. The Agent controls its own tools. **Stop** cancels the current turn; the Agent remains responsible for stopping its own tools, and tools without a reported result remain unfinished. Press Enter to queue a message, which supported Agents continue in the same Agent session. With DSH's experimental Agent Teams enabled, you can view member progress and handle approvals from the main conversation.

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Troubleshooting and feedback：| Symptom                              | First check                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Command will not start               | Check the Agent executable path and try an absolute path.                                                |
| Sign-in or authentication fails      | Sign in through the Agent CLI and check configured environment variables.                                |
| Older subagent details will not open | Follow the native recovery notice; incompatible old details remain in local history with an error shown. |
| Session requests recovery            | Follow the composer notice and **ACP Diagnostics**; do not clear local data.                             |

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Troubleshooting and feedback：Export the safe summary JSON from **ACP Diagnostics**; it excludes message text, commands, paths, raw session IDs, and ACP credentials. DSH's native session-log ZIP may contain prompts, tool arguments, file paths, and attachments; inspect and redact it before sharing.

@zaimokuza/dsh-acp-adapter README · Troubleshooting and feedback：For help, open an [issue](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/issues) with the error reference, DSH/plugin versions, and redacted log excerpts. See the [native reuse boundaries](https://github.com/zaimokuza-yoshiteru/dsh-acp-adapter/blob/v0.2.1-rc.4.1/docs/native-reuse.en.md).
